data.body: CI FOLLOW-UP FROM STUCK-RUN INVESTIGATION: after 1129 merged, Gerrit 1130 was rebased as PS5 ca0d08354 and run 30678399352 completed (no hang) with Verified -1. All four matrix cells failed the same three tests in tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_write_ahead_recovery.py: test_keyless_pending_miss_unbinds (expected recovered/unbound after one miss, now remains pending), test_write_ahead_orders_pending_before_create_and_key_before_label (shared store still contains the retained pending record, so create is deferred), and test_bind_pending_persist_failure_skips_create (same retained-state contamination means the later create path is deferred before bind_pending). Cell suite times were 4m20s, 5m48s, 6m18s, and 12m15s. Run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30678399352. This appears to be stale test semantics/fixture isolation after the intentional corroborated-miss change, not a production hang. No edit made because this ticket remains claimed by its originating session.
